newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct-Dec stainless steel demand to drop -- MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct-Dec stainless steel demand to drop -- MITI.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of International Trade and Industry said on Thursday that it forecast Japan's stainless steel demand for the October-December quarter at 180,300 tonnes per month, down 2.2 percent from a year ago.
The estimated demand for the October-December quarter, however, would be up slightly from the forecast demand of 178,000 tonnes for July-September, the ministry said in a statement.
Total demand for special steel in the fourth quarter of 1996 is estimated at 973,700 tonnes, up 3.3 percent from a year ago, it said.
